title: No test opens the Help and feedback sheet from the round button
what: Tests check where the round button sits and when it hides, and the Settings page box, but no test opens the sheet itself. Its title, the greyed Send on an empty box, the red 'Couldn't send' line with the message kept, and a half-typed message kept after closing are never checked.
expected: A phone test opens the sheet from the round button, checks the empty-box Send is off, sends while offline and sees the red line with the message still there, and closes and reopens with the half-typed text kept.
fix_line: Add one phone test that drives the sheet from the round button, online and offline

title: The help questions test passes even when no AI answer and no 'Sending' line ever show
what: The phone test waits for the 'Sending' line to be gone, which also passes if it never appeared, and then accepts any of three outcomes. No test checks the 'Answer written by AI from our help pages.' label or the Yes and No buttons on the phone.
expected: A test shows the 'Sending' line first, then a quick answer card with the AI label and Yes and No, and after a tap 'Great! Glad it helped.' with the buttons gone.
fix_line: Make the phone test wait for the Sending line, then check the AI label and the rating buttons

title: Speaking a message: cancel, the 2-minute stop, too short and microphone refused have no test
what: Tests check the voice server's answers and that heard words go under typed words. No test checks that a cancelled recording adds nothing and is never sent, that recording stops by itself at 2:00, the 'too short' line, or the microphone-refused line with Open Settings.
expected: Tests for cancel, the 2:00 stop, a too-short clip and a refused microphone, each checking the words and that no clip is sent when it should not be.
fix_line: Add small tests for the recorder's cancel, time limit, too-short and refused-microphone paths

title: Sending the watch screen log with a message has no test of the order or the result lines
what: Tests check what the watch log holds and that the switch shows only when a log exists. Nothing checks that the log goes after the message and only once, never with the switch off, that the switch turns back off, or the 'sent too' and 'was not sent' lines.
expected: A test sends a message with the switch on and off, offline and online, and checks the log is sent once after the message only when on, and the right line shows.
fix_line: Add a test of the sheet's send step with the watch log switch

title: Saving changes to a past workout that fails has no test
what: The save-problem tests cover the live workout and Finish only. The line 'Couldn't save your changes. They're still open - tap Save changes again.' and keeping the edits after a failed save are never tested.
expected: A test makes a past-workout edit fail to save and checks the line shows, the edits are kept, and an autosave elsewhere does not clear the line.
fix_line: Add a test for a failed save of a past workout edit
